_comment: Deployment manifest for the barlavento.eco community map. mode=view: this is the published map, not the workbench. The renderer here is byte-identical to the one at valedalama/vdl-orgdev and to the lab's — if this file ever needs a code change to serve this community, that is the bug.
title: barlavento.eco
banner: Who works with whom, in the Barlavento. Each circle is a project in the Ecosystem Regeneration Community. Each line is a working relationship the projects have reported — people they share, or a formal affiliation. Networks they belong to and places they have in common are marked on the projects themselves rather than drawn as lines, so the map stays about who actually works together. The list is maintained by Mud Valley Foundation and will keep changing as the community grows.
